business.name: Lagoon Plant Hire
business.about: An equipment hire yard renting out generators, concrete mixers, scaffolding, compactors, drills, pumps and a marquee.

dayTitle: A Monday at Lagoon Plant Hire

moments.title: Is a generator free for three days?
moments.problem: A caller wants a 7.5 kVA generator from tomorrow, and wants to know what it will cost.
moments.handles: Availability is counted by unit, not by item, so Funmi sees that two of the three are free for those dates. The quote is the days times the rate times the units, and a part day counts as a whole one.

moments.title: Not promised to two customers
moments.problem: The generator must not be given to someone else who calls at ten.
moments.handles: The agreement reserves a specific unit for the dates, with the deposit due and who brings it back, the customer or our collector. A unit can never be held twice at the same time, and one that is out and not back stays held past its due time.

moments.title: A mixer and a compactor go out
moments.problem: If there is a dispute later, Lagoon Plant Hire needs proof of what condition they left in.
moments.handles: Hand-out needs every unit's tag scanned, notes and photos of its condition signed by the customer, and the deposit first when your settings ask for it.

moments.title: Two items are overdue
moments.problem: A generator and a compactor should have come back over the weekend.
moments.handles: Returns due lists what should come back, in the order it is due. A late fee starts after the grace minutes, at the item's late rate. Until the item is back, the fee so far is shown, and it is charged on return.

moments.title: The mixer comes back dented
moments.problem: Last week's mixer is back from Ojota Builders with a dent in the drum.
moments.handles: The return records the condition against the hand-out. The damaged unit gets a proposed damage line and leaves the calendar until it is mended.

moments.title: The customer disagrees
moments.problem: Mr Bamidele says the dent was there before.
moments.handles: Tunde compares the photos and confirms the damage charge, or waives it. Either way, the customer's comment is kept on the file.

moments.title: Closing the hire
moments.problem: The agreement must be settled and the deposit balanced.
moments.handles: Settling needs every damage line decided. Rent, the late fee and the confirmed damage go on one customer invoice. The deposit pays the charges first, and the rest is recorded as refunded the way it was paid. The deposit is kept as the customer's money, never income.

moments.title: The site wants the scaffolding longer
moments.problem: Ajah Plaza works needs the scaffolding for another two weeks.
moments.handles: The agreement is extended, and the units stay held for the new dates.

modulesTitle: The parts of Clafina a hire business uses

faq.q: Is it for car, tool and party hire too?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment, party, car and tool hire all run on items, units and agreements.

faq.q: Can the same generator be promised twice?
faq.a: No. An agreement holds specific units, and a unit can never be held twice at the same time.

faq.q: How do we prove what condition an item left in?
faq.a: Every unit's tag is scanned at hand-out, and the customer signs the condition notes and photos. The return is compared with them.
It is held as the customer's money. When the hire is settled it pays the charges first, and the rest is recorded as refunded the way it was paid.

faq.q: Can we charge less a day for a long hire?
faq.a: Yes. You can set week and month discounts for longer hires.
